title: Approved aspect ratio
description: Video must be 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1.
source_quote: Accepted aspect ratios: 16:9 (1920×1080) for web and TV, 9:16 (1080×1920)

title: Minimum resolution
description: The short side must be at least 1080 px; 720p or lower is rejected.
source_quote: Minimum resolution is 1080 px on the short side.

title: Approved frame rate
description: Frame rate must be 25 or 30 fps.
source_quote: Frame rate must be 25 or 30 fps.

title: Approved duration
description: Length must be 6, 15 or 30 seconds, within 0.5 s.
source_quote: Approved lengths are 6, 15 and 30 seconds, with a tolerance of ±0.5 seconds.

title: Integrated loudness
description: Integrated loudness must be -16 LUFS ±1.5 LU.
source_quote: Integrated loudness: −16 LUFS ±1.5 LU for web and social.

title: True peak limit
description: True peak must not exceed -1 dBTP; no clipping.
source_quote: True peak must not exceed −1 dBTP. No clipping or distortion.

title: No rapid flashing
description: No content may flash more than 3 times per second.
source_quote: No flashing content more than 3 times per second.

title: Brand visible early
description: The logo or brand name must be visible within the first 2 seconds.
source_quote: The Lumora logo or brand name must be visible within the first 2 seconds.
criterion: Is the Lumora logo or brand name visible within the first 2 seconds of the video?

title: Logo bug in top-right
description: A persistent logo bug sits in the top-right corner inside the 5% safe margin, never another corner.
source_quote: A persistent logo bug sits in the top-right corner, inside the 5% safe margin
criterion: Is the persistent logo bug located in the top-right corner of the frame, inside a 5% margin, and not in any other corner?

title: Logo bug size
description: The logo bug must be 8-12% of the frame width.
source_quote: The bug must be 8–12% of the frame width.
criterion: Is the logo bug roughly 8-12% of the frame width?

title: No bug on end card
description: The logo bug is removed during the end card so the logo does not appear twice.
source_quote: Remove the bug during the end card so the logo does not appear twice.
criterion: During the end card, is the corner logo bug absent so the logo appears only once?

title: End card present
description: Every video ends with a 2-second end card: full logo centered on solid Lumora Violet or Midnight.
source_quote: Every video ends with a 2-second end card: the full logo centered on a solid Lumora Violet or Midnight background.
criterion: Does the video end with an approximately 2-second end card showing the full logo centered on a solid Lumora Violet (#5B2EFF) or Midnight (#14142B) background?

title: End card tagline
description: The tagline 'Light up every moment.' appears under the logo in Inter Regular, Cloud White.
source_quote: The tagline "Light up every moment." appears beneath the logo in Inter Regular, Cloud White.

title: Inter typeface only
description: All on-screen text uses Inter; serif typefaces are never used.
source_quote: On-screen text uses Inter only
criterion: Is all on-screen text set in the Inter sans-serif typeface, with no serif or other typefaces?

title: Minimum text size
description: On-screen text height is at least 4% of the frame height.
source_quote: Text height at least 4% of the frame height.

title: Maximum two lines
description: On-screen text has no more than 2 lines.
source_quote: No more than 2 lines, and no more than 8 words per line.

title: Maximum words per line
description: No more than 8 words per line of on-screen text.
source_quote: No more than 2 lines, and no more than 8 words per line.

title: Text in title-safe area
description: All on-screen text stays inside the 10% title-safe area.
source_quote: Keep all text inside the 10% title-safe area.

title: Approved text colors
description: Text is Cloud White on brand colors or footage, Midnight on white.
source_quote: Cloud White on brand colors or footage; Midnight on white.

title: Burned-in captions
description: Web and social videos carry burned-in captions in the lower third, Cloud White Inter Regular on a semi-transparent Midnight box.
source_quote: All web and social videos must carry burned-in captions for every spoken line and key message
criterion: Does the video show burned-in captions in the lower third, centered, in white text on a semi-transparent dark box?

title: No green
description: No green backgrounds or graphics at any point.
source_quote: No green backgrounds or graphics at any point.

title: Brand palette only
description: Backgrounds, shapes, lower thirds and transitions use only the brand palette.
source_quote: Backgrounds, shapes, lower thirds and transitions use only the brand palette

title: Coral stays an accent
description: Sunrise Coral covers no more than about 20% of any layout.
source_quote: it should cover no more than about 20% of any layout

title: Text contrast
description: Text keeps at least 4.5:1 contrast with its background.
source_quote: Maintain at least 4.5:1 contrast between text and background.

title: Warm upbeat music, no lyrics under voiceover
description: Music is warm and upbeat with no lyrics under voiceover.
source_quote: Music should be warm and upbeat. No lyrics underneath voiceover.
criterion: Is the music warm and upbeat, with no lyrics under any voiceover?

title: No hype words in on-screen text
description: On-screen copy avoids hype words such as 'revolutionary', 'insane' or 'game-changing'. Spoken copy is not checked.
source_quote: Avoid hype words such as "revolutionary", "insane" or "game-changing".

title: Brand name spelling
description: The brand name is written as Lumora in running text, never LUMORA or lumora.
source_quote: Always write the brand name as Lumora (capital L), never LUMORA or lumora in running text.
criterion: Where the brand name appears in running text, is it written as 'Lumora'?
